content: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad: Third University in Iran The Information Center and Central Library (ICCL) Faculty Libraries Library of the Education and Psychology Library of Dr. Ali Shariati Letters and Humanities The Library of Morteza Motahhari Theology and Islamic Studies You are here: Libraries / The Information Center and Central Library (ICCL) The Information Center and Central Library (ICCL) The Information Center and Central Library (ICCL) was established in 1971 at the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. The aim of this library is to collect, organize, and provide access to scientific information and information sources needed to promote education and research. This means that the main objective of this Library is to provide the researchers with direct access to the latest scientific information and resources. So the following tasks are considered for the Information Center and Central Library: Collecting library materials, including print, non-print, and electronic materials Performing technical services (cataloguing, organizing and indexing) all the sources of the libraries at the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad Assessing the condition and performance of faculty libraries Holding short-term training courses on Library and Information Science Guiding and training the users for retrieving and using information resources Achieving the above mentioned objectives, the following sections are established Circulation Services Publications Information Service Audio-visual Education and communication Systems Support Theses Organization of resources Acquisition Reading Room and Computer Site Reference Blind and Low-Vision services Users Group 1: Working, retired and Sessional Faculty members of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad Group 2: The students of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad in different educational levels Group 3: All working and retired staff of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad Group 4: The patrons from outside of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad including experts and researchers of other universities, organizations, institutions, libraries, governmental and non-governmental sector upon agreement with Information Center and Central Library Working hours All sections Saturday to Thursday 8 am to 14 pm All section Thursday 8 am to 11.30 Reading halls all days 8 am to 22:45 Library services Renewing and reserving the resources through the Portal instructional programs and workshops Ghadir Project (resource sharing) Amin Project (Interlibrary loan) book Request for purchase through the Portal Article provision in Persian and English Reference and information services Outreach services information Consultation services services to patrons with special needs Ask a Librarian Thesis Services Internship services for the students of Information Science and Knowledge Studies Copying, printing, bookbinding and other services Library Buffet Communications Office and Instruction Services Communications and Instruction Services Office was founded in 2013 in Information Center and Central Library at Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. The aim of this office is to increase the knowledge of users in regard to the information and information sources available in the Library and around the world and to help them learn how to have access to this information. The main aim of this office is to support two important roles of the university. That is, to support the achievement of the educational and research activities of university members. In this regard, Communications and Instruction Services Office hold training sessions at various levels for students (graduate students in particular), faculty members and staff. The main objective of such training is to increase the use in the Information Center and Central Library and the scientific productivity of users and also increase the effectiveness and efficiency of scientific activities in the Universities. Duties Providing instruction programs for: Faculty members Instructional librarians students at different educational levels Communicating with faculty members, students and university staff with the aim to identify their instructional needs Cooperating with other sessions for holding Library tours and Information Literacy sessions Interacting with other libraries and information centers, national, professional and local associations to identify their resources and specialized services and to provide referral services Communicating with faculty authorities to identify specific events, activities and programs (such as Book Week, Research Week, etc.) in which The Information Center and Central Library can participate The Office of Information Services The Office of Information Services is one of the critical parts of the Information Center and Central Library which was established in 1999 at the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. This office follows the following objectives: Identifying the needs of academic community and trying to meet these needs Updating the services in-line with the developments of the society, changes in information production and the diverse needs of the community of users Providing quick and easy access to information resources to support educational and research purposes Activities To provide conventional and distance information services to users To hold Information Literacy programs, orientation Library tours and one to one training sessions To prepare manuals, handbooks and training packages To train the interns of Information Science and Knowledge Studies To cooperate with the committee of electronic resources of the Central Library To manage and support the website of Information Center and Central Library To selectively disseminate the current information and awareness services through the publication of an electronic newsletter and posting on the site of Central Library and ... To provide electronic resources services (including electronic journals, electronic books, electronic and Internet information, …) To provide services on databases Circulation Services Circulation Services Section was established at Information Center and Central Library of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. Holding over 160 thousand volume of books in Persian and 94 thousand volume in Latin, this section provides services to more than 30 thousand members. Book stack is open access and users have unrestricted access to the resources. The arrangement of the materials of the Library is subject based. The classification of library resources is according to the Library of Congress Classification System. Making the most efficient use of the library materials in Circulation Services Section, the patrons should consider the points mentioned below Circulation Services are provided just to the owner of the valid "student card" Borrowers can renew their books either through the Portal (student / faculty / staff) or in person Rental Book Return Deadline is provided in the portal Any borrower who fails to return an item in time will be fined 1000 Rials for each day Thesis and Dissertation Services Section Thesis & Dissertation Services Section was founded in 1971 at Information Center and Central Library of Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. This section is stocked with a great number of Theses in Persian, English, French and Arabic from different disciplines available in the University. In addition, the reports of university research projects are organized and preserved in Thesis & Dissertation Services Section. According to amalgamation Plan in 2012, the postgraduate theses which were preserved in faculty libraries have been transferred to this Library. Following this event, a considerable number of both internal and external patrons refer to this section to make use of these resources. Users of this section should follow the following regulations Theses are not available for loan, either to individuals or via interlibrary loan Making photocopies of theses is limited to table of contents, Persian abstract, Latin abstract, references, questionnaire and attachments Scanning and taking a photo of the thesis (even the permitted sections) is prohibited. In case of being detected, the case will be reported to the University Security In order to protect the theses, no drink is allowed in the this hall Audio-visual Services Section Audio-visual Services Section was established in 2008 at Information Center and Central Library of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. This section aims to collect applications software and as well as educational videos and the like. Organizing these resources, Audio-visual Services Section to facilitate borrowing these items and their searching process through library software. Currently, more than 7,000 Compact Discs are available in this section. Duties Providing teachers and students and academic users with the needed audio visual and electronic resources Preparing electronic version of the available videos Cataloging the audiovisual resources Preparing the resources for loan through Circulation Services System of the library and the Sadaf System of the University Providing Online Search Service Providing instructional services to users in the form of instructional compact discs. Providing SDI services for new arrivals Organizing educational Compact Discs on various topics Helping users install available software Purchase and install all needed software on library computers Technical Services Section Technical Services Section was established in 1971 at Information Center and Central Library of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. The main aim of this section is to provide systematic arrangement for library materials and to facilitate access to these information sources through searching in the comprehensive Library System as well as and reviewing them in library stack. Cataloging process also make possible Circulation Services. In this regard, Technical Services Section conducted all activities needed to make accessible the resources of the Libraries of the Ferdowsi University. Activities Organizing the available resources of the Libraries of the Ferdowsi University Providing Cataloging In Publication (CIP) Services for all books published by active publishers in the Khorasan Razavi Province Preparing the Library resources for loan Study Halls and Computer Room Study Halls & Computer Room were founded in 2012 at Information Center and Central Library of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. The objective of establishing these spaces was to provide a calm and relaxed places for study and scientific research of students of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. In this building, four separate halls are dedicated for the study of ladies and gents with a capacity of 500 people. There exists a computer site with a capacity of 180 computers beside the study hall. Wi-Fi services is available in Study hall and computer room for all applicants. Acquisition & Collection Development Section Acquisition & Collection Development Section was established in 1971 at Information Center and Central Library of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. Benefiting from experienced and educated librarians and experts this section tries to provide the resources needed for an academic library. Establishing consulting committee for purchasing and providing library materials help build an effective and efficient library collection. Duties Identifying the resources ordered and needed by faculty members, students, and researchers Preparing Persian and Latin resources including books, periodicals, audio-visual materials, and database with the help of subject specialists (representatives of educational departments) Providing software needed by users of the library Adding records and updating the databases of Persian and Latin periodicals of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad Participating in National Book Exhibitions to purchase library materials Holding Book Exhibitions inside the University Training Librarians of other universities and interns students of Department of Information Science and Knowledge Studies Providing consulting services to applicants from other universities in person or through different communication media (i.e., the Internet, telephone or snail mail) Weeding library materials annually Donated Collections Section Donated Collections Section was founded in 2004 at Information Center and Central Library of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. With regard to the spiritual value of donation and endowment, professors and researchers who have an exquisite and valuable collection are invited to participate in this matter Currently, the library contains one collection endowed and two donated The Prof. Kazem Modir-shanechi endowed collection: Contains 7 hundred thousands printed books and 1500 Lithographs and Manuscripts that are in the field of Fiqh and Islamic sciences and Islamic history The donated Collection of Researcher Ahmed Mohades Khorasani: Includes 5 thousand printed books and one hundred Lithographs and Manuscripts that are in the field of Fiqh and Islamic sciences and Islamic history The donated Collection of Scholar Mohammad Hossein Farzin – Alieh Ghaffari: Covers 8 thousand new and old printed books in the field of the literary history of Iran and the world All these collections are preserved in the Donated collections of the Central Library of Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. All library users can have access to these valuable collections within the library Reference Services Section Reference Services Section was founded in 1996 at Information Center and Central Library of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. This section, includes a variety of outstanding reference sources. The information sources are prepared according to the education and research needs of different disciplines of the Ferdowsi University. Reference Services Section is located in an area of 740 square meters in two halls and is cover 12104 Persian and Latin reference books. Activities Answering different kinds of questions including referential, fact based, thematic, and specific search questions Providing reference services via phone, chat and e-mail Consulting and helping the students in selecting research topics according to the reference and non-reference resources Accompanying and helping users to perform subject searches Training the patrons how to use the reference materials Cooperating with lecturers in running part of research method classes in the Library and introducing subject information sources to the class Holding reference services instruction to individuals and groups Training Librarians of other universities and interns students of Department of Information Science and Knowledge Studies (ISKS) Helping ISKS students in doing Reference assignments Preparing educational pamphlets and guides to show the patrons how to use the reference materials Helping the researchers find "information sources and reference materials" to conduct their research providing consultation and guidance services on supplying the reference sources for other libraries and information centers Receiving purchase requests for new resources needed by patrons in person, by phone, chat or e-mail Blind and Low-Vision Services Section Blind and Low-Vision Services Section was established in 2013 at Information Center and Central Library of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. This section, provides services to Blind and Low-Vision students of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. A collection of information and research resources in hard copy and electronically has been prepared for these users with special need. Braille Library includes 1210 Braille books on various thematic areas Audio Library contains 370 audio books on literary and scientific fields. This library intends to complete the full collection of audio books in the near future Recording studio: Recording Studio is in fact a subset of Audio Library containing a room being used to record and produce audio books Duties To provide required hardware and software To collect the resources needed by the Blind and Low-Vision users To provide library services to Blind and Low-Vision users Periodical/Series Services Section Periodical/Series Services Section was founded in 1993 at Information Center and Central Library of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. The main aim of this section is acquisition, archiving periodicals and providing related services to the academic community. Collecting current and retrospective journals, Periodical Services Section has managed to provide a relatively rich collection, so that it meets the research needs of the academic members of the University. Access to the full text and abstracts of more than 6,000 Latin and Persian journals is provided through the periodical databases. This section, however, consists of two parts namely current periodicals and retrospective periodicals. In current collection there are 558 Persian and 326 Latin periodical. In retrospective part there over 7344 bounded volume which covers 140 Persian journals as well as 30,000 bounded volume which covers more than 1200 Latin journals. The retrospective Farsi periodicals collected from 1951 and in Latin periodicals from 1930. content: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad: Third University in Iran Research Centers Aviation Technology Research Institute Cognitive Science Research Center Earthquake Research Center (EQRC) Environmental Chemistry Research Center Groundwater Research Center (GRC) Institute of Applied Zoology Management Research Center Institute for Islamic Studies in Humanities (IISH) Research Center for Ore Deposit of Eastern Iran (CODEI) Research Center for Social and Cultural Issues of Central Asia Research Center for Social Studies Research Center for the Economics of East Iran and Neighbor Countries Research Center for Plant Sciences Research Center for Wavelets Applications in Linear and Nonlinear Systems Research Institute of Oil & Gas Rural Geography Research Centre Sun-Air Research Institute (SARI) The Research Institute of Biotechnology (RIB) Techno-Economic Road Safety Research Center Urban and Regional Research Center of North East of Iran Centers of Excellence Center of Excellence in Analysis on Algebraic Structures (CEAAS) Center of Excellence in Ruminant Abortion and Neonatal Mortality Ordered and Spatial Data Center of Excellence Center of Excellence in Ferdowsi and Shahname Center of Excellence in Soft Computing and Intelligent Information Processing (SCIIP) Center of Excellence in Special Crops Publications Journals Other academic products You are here: Research / Centers of Excellence Center of Excellence (CE) The increasing progress in science and technology in recent decades has caused an increase in the scientific gap between the developing and the developed countries. In Iran, some studies were carried out at the beginning of the third economic, social and cultural development plan regarding this issue and the scientific indicators of the country were compared to other developed and developing countries. The result of such studies showed the gap between Iran’s scientific status and well-developed countries. One of the solutions proposed for solving this underdevelopment is the formation of CEs in universities to initiate a competitive advantage among universities. Because of financial and human resource constraints, all universities cannot act according to international standards. Therefore, it was suggested that educational or research departments, which were in reasonable advantage in terms of equipment and human resources and are determined to participate in the advancement of knowledge and improvement of their quality, be introduced as CEs in order to be supported legally and financially. By carrying out projects of establishing academic excellence in universities and research institutions of the country in the Third Socio-economic Development Plan, the extent of scientific and research activities and their quality have significantly increased. Due to the valuable results of the activities of CE in the Third Plan, the continuation of these activities in the Fourth Development Plan was also considered. The Fourth Development Plan has clearly put emphasis on creating centers of academic excellence on the basis of relative advantages and the country’s future needs. Also, concepts and perspectives like knowledge-based development, supporting demand-oriented researches, university reform, qualitative and quantitative development of higher education in compliance with software movement needs, can be effective in the orientation of CE. A Center of Excellence is the symbol of the organized activity of a group of academic staff in a higher institution having high scientific capabilities, that is recognized for its excellence in a scientific-professional field of basic or applied sciences and by giving focus and coherence to their activities in that field they try to achieve better scientific quality and innovation at national, regional or international levels. This would respond to the fulfillment of the country’s basic needs. Top

content: Two Ferdowsi University of Mashhad journals were indexed in the DOAJ (Directory of Open Access Journals) database :: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad :: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad: Third University in Iran The Journal of Quran and Hadith Sciences, edited by Dr. Hassan Naghizadeh, a faculty member of the Quran and Hadith Sciences Department of the Faculty of Theology and Islamic Studies, and the Journal of Social Sciences of Ferdowsi University of Mashhad, edited by Dr. Hossein Bahravan, a faculty member of the Social Sciences Department of the Faculty of Literature and Humanities, have been granted the prestigious DOAJ (Directory of Open Access Journals) index. title: A Faculty Member of Ferdowsi University of Mashhad has achieved Rajabalipour Award in the Field of Pure Mathematics  :: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad :: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad: Third University in Iran
content: A Faculty Member of Ferdowsi University of Mashhad has achieved Rajabalipour Award in the Field of Pure Mathematics :: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad :: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad: Third University in Iran At the 13th International Seminar on Linear Algebra and Its Applications, hosted by Arak University in Ordibehesht 1404, the Rajabalipour Prize in the field of pure mathematics was awarded to Prof. Mohammad Sal Moslehian, a faculty member of Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. This award was given to Prof. Sal Moslehian in recognition of his influential research in the field of linear algebra, especially in the field of linear operators on matrices and Hilbert spaces with infinite dimension, as well as the geometry of these spaces. Prof. Sal Moslehian is one of the prominent figures in Iranian mathematics, whose research has been published in prestigious journals in this field, such as the Journal of Linear Algebra and Its Applications (Elsevier), Linear and Multilinear Algebra (Taylor & Francis), and the Journal of Operator Theory (published by the Institute of Mathematics of the Romanian Academy and the American Mathematical Society). The Rajabalipour Prize is one of the prestigious scientific awards of the Iranian Mathematical Society, presented every two years to the best researchers in the field of linear algebra, encompassing both pure and applied aspects. This prize not only reflects the scientific excellence of researchers in this field but also serves as an essential step towards promoting fundamental research in Iranian mathematics.

content: Opening of the first phase of the Mathematical Center complex at the Faculty of Mathematical Sciences of Ferdowsi University of Mashhad :: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad :: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad: Third University in Iran Opening of the first phase of the Mathematical Center complex at the Faculty of Mathematical Sciences of Ferdowsi University of Mashhad The opening ceremony of the first phase of the "Mathematics House" complex was held on Saturday, June 7, 2025, in the presence of members of the Faculty Council, faculty members, students, and staff of the Faculty of Mathematical Sciences. This scientific space was designed and launched to promote and deepen the culture of mathematics, creating a suitable platform for educational, research, and promotional activities. At the beginning of the ceremony, Prof. Sal Moslehian, Dean of the Faculty of Mathematical Sciences, expressed his appreciation for the valuable support of Prof. Habib Rajabi Mashadi, Head of the University's Research and Technology Office, and honored his role in realizing this project. Dr. Sal Moslehian also appreciated the efforts of all colleagues who participated in launching this complex. Subsequently, the "Mathematics House" complex was opened in the presence of Prof. Majid Mirzavaziri, faculty member of the Faculty of Mathematical Sciences, in recognition of his years of sincere efforts and valuable services in promoting and developing mathematics at the national and international levels. It is worth noting that immediately after its opening, this complex was met with a remarkable reception from the mathematics community and students and was considered a dynamic space for educational interactions.

title: Commencement of the master plan for developing technologies to improve subsurface imaging in the exploration of hydrocarbon resources in the Kopeh Dagh sedimentary basin at Ferdowsi University of Mash :: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad :: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad: Third University in Iran
content: Commencement of the master plan for developing technologies to improve subsurface imaging in the exploration of hydrocarbon resources in the Kopeh Dagh sedimentary basin at Ferdowsi University of Mash :: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad :: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad: Third University in Iran The first phase of the master plan "Development of subsurface imaging improvement technologies in hydrocarbon resource exploration in the Kopeh Dagh sedimentary basin" to create technological capabilities in the oil and gas exploration sector and form an innovation network and business formation in the field of subsurface imaging technologies, has been defined as follows and successfully implemented under difficult sanctions conditions. The technology development roadmap has been developed within the framework of the first package, and accordingly, the research projects of the second package have been defined in two phases and under the title of completing the database data by providing a program to conduct the necessary studies and experiments at three laboratory, semi-industrial and industrial scales. Currently, the first phase of the second package, including 6 projects, has been completed with 100% realization of the anticipated goals. In addition to the universities of Tehran (Institute of Geophysics and Institute of Petroleum), Amirkabir University of Technology, Zanjan Postgraduate Education, and Daqing Normal University, international companies and experts from Russia, Switzerland, Norway, and Mexico have participated in the research project with Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. In the continuation of the implementation of the second phase of the second package of the plan, five project titles with a credit of over 190 billion rials and 2 million and 800 thousand euros have been approved and announced. Considering the university's scientific, administrative capacities, and valuable infrastructure in the fields of reservoir exploration studies, geomechanical studies, and increased recovery, as well as the network of partners formed during the implementation of the plan, Ferdowsi University of Mashhad has announced its readiness to launch a Center for New Exploration Technologies.

title: Joint meeting of the President of Ferdowsi University of Mashhad with Rear Admiral Habibollah Sayyari :: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad :: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad: Third University in Iran
content: Joint meeting of the President of Ferdowsi University of Mashhad with Rear Admiral Habibollah Sayyari :: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad :: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad: Third University in Iran Prof. Javan Jafari, the President of Ferdowsi University of Mashhad, met and discussed with Rear Admiral Habibollah Sayyari, Deputy Coordinator of the General Command of the Islamic Republic of Iran Army on Sunday, June 25, 2025, In this meeting, which was attended by a group of commanders of the Navy, Air Force, Passive Defense, and Rangers of the Islamic Republic of Iran Army, in addition to emphasizing the expansion of cooperation between Ferdowsi University of Mashhad and the executive branches, issues such as utilizing the capacity and capabilities of Ferdowsi University of Mashhad students and the capacities of the Faculty of Engineering in the field of defense production were discussed. Admiral Sayyari, while expressing his pleasure at being at Ferdowsi University of Mashhad and the invitation to participate in the grand program linking epics from Toos to Khorramshahr, considered such programs to be a factor in strengthening religious and national identity. In this regard, he appreciated and thanked the university president.

Mashhad, with around 3 million inhabitants, is the second most populous city in Iran. It is located in the northeast of the country and is the capital of Razavi Khorasan province. Mashhad features a steppe climate with hot summers and cool winters. The city only sees about 250 millimeters of precipitation per year, some of which occasionally falls in the form of snow. Summers are typically hot and dry, with high temperatures sometimes exceeding 35 °C. Winters are typically cool to cold and somewhat damper, with overnight lows routinely dropping below freezing. Mashhad enjoys on average just above 2900 hours of sunshine per year. Emam Reza (the eighth Emam of Shia) shrine complex is located in the heart of Mashhad city, which includes a huge mosque (Goharshaad), a library and several museums. Monuments There are many tombs of historical celebrities inside and nearby Mashhad, e.g. the tombs of Ferdowsi (Persian poet of 10th-11th centuries), Nader Shah (one of the powerful Iranian kings, ruling in the 18th century),  and Khayyam (Persian mathematician of 11th-12th centuries). Shopping The most important traditional shopping centers of Mashhad are Bazaar-e Reza, Bazaar-e bozorg -e markazy , Almas-e Shargh and Zist Khavar, where you can buy different Khorassan crafts, jewelry, saffron, textile, dried fruits, nuts and so on. Iranian cuisine The suburb area of Mashhad is mountainous with several summer resorts and village restaurants. Indeed, Iran is the land of skewed kebabs (BBQ), but Iranian cuisine is much more diverse, complicated and difficult to be made than that. There are different kinds of stew dishes (called Khoresh) made as combinations of meat, vegetables, legumes, and nuts. Both skewed kebab and Iranian stews are served with fragrant (but not sticky) Persian rice. Persian cuisine is tasty but not spicy. Top

Studies on master plan programming, design, and implementation can be categorized into 14 chapters: 1. Basic Studies; 2. Educational Programming; 3. Spatial- Physical Cognition; 4. University’s Buildings Identification; 5. Principles of University Spaces Design; 6. World Case Study; 7. Spatial Analysis of Campus Land uses; 8. Physical Programming Principles; 9. Campus Design Principles; 10. Transportation and Traffic; 11. Campus Signs; 12. Landscape and Environment; 13. Passive Defense; 14. Building and Construction Details. In recent years, Islamic countries have considered “Islamic traditions and Contemporary Design” as the principles of university's outlook. Due to the physical needs and value-oriented viewpoints, the physical outlook of Ferdowsi University of Mashhad can be determined as below: Development and improvement of the university’s spatial needs following the sustainable development of Iranian- Islamic architecture patterns. Environment improvement, resource conservation, and green university achievement have been noted as the main goal of physical programming. Design strategies can be categorized into the UI GreenMeteric WUR criteria: 1. Setting and Infrastructures; 2. Energy and Climate Changes; 3. Waste; 4. Water; 5. Transportation and 6. Education. The ambition for achieving these criteria led the design team to focus on reducing environmental damages and spreading the use of renewable energies and green technologies. The main goals of FUM are as follows: Increasing place attachment and creating a strong sense of place; Developing a scientific, healthy, and creative environment; Creating sociable environments and desirable interaction; Considering architecture, urban and environmental design criteria (to achieve a green campus); Relationship between internal learning environments and external society; Promoting the current situation; Increasing environment legibility; Education, research, and experience in a responsive environment; Sustainable campus as an urban-regional sign. According to mentioned goals, the design strategies in the campus master plan are: Relationship with the city; Consideration of Iranian-Islamic architecture patterns following contemporary design principles; Green architecture design; Campus walkways development; Creating linking buildings; Space optimization; Environmentally adaptive architecture; Use of the latest space standards Considering future universities' architectural principles; Creating social learning centers in 9 zones of the campus; Creating a legible spatial network over the campus; Use of on-site ecological potentials and renovation of the stream as the ecologic axis; To legible the 12 faculties' borders; To unify the same land uses and avoid diffused buildings over the campus; To create recreational and desirable environments for students and other users; Green light transportation system on the main axis of the campus; The Legible entrances for campus; Creating a socio-physical area in heart of the campus; To increase accessibility to different destinations over the campus; Maximum use of current buildings and renovating them; Minimum of destruction and maximum flexibility in future buildings; Respect for the physical-spatial history of the campus and reviving the memories; and To achieve 90 sqm public per capita and 27 sqm spatial per capita for each student. content: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad: Third University in Iran FUM Officials FUM Presidents A word from the President Vice Presidents Vice President for Academic Affairs College of Ferdowsi University of Mashhad Educational Planning and Academic Development Office E-Learning Center Vice President for Socio-Cultural and Student affairs Office of Cultural Affairs and Voluntary Activities Physical Education Administration Office of Health and Welfare Consulting Center for Cultural and Social Empowerment Vice President for Research and Technology Laboratory Network Management Office Office of Industrial Relations Research Management Office Center for Knowledge-based Business Incubator Unites in Humanities Director of FUM President’s Office and Public Relations The History Site Map Strategic Plan FUM Catalogs in Three Languages: English, French and Russian Center for Documents and Scientific Records of Eminent University Figures Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Center Campus Master Plan External Links Alzahra University Amirkabir University of Technology Golestan University Shahid Beheshti University Sharif University of Technology Shiraz University Tarbiat Modares University University of Guilan University of Isfahan University of Sistan and Baluchestan University of Tabriz University of Tehran Yazd University You are here: About / The History The History of Ferdowsi University of Mashhad The first proposal for launching the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad was announced concurrently with the establishment of Tehran University in 1934. However, the first step was converting the Higher Institute of Public Health to a Medical Faculty in 1949. Shortly after, the Medical Faculty admitted its first group of medical students, and in December 1949 this institute was officially inaugurated as the first Center for Medical Sciences in the North East of Iran by the Minister of Culture, the late Dr. Zanganeh. Finally in 1956 after the foundation of the facultys of Literature and Theology, the complex was named "Mashhad University". Later on in 1957, the rules and regulations for employment and education of Tehran University were adopted for use in this new university. Since then other faculties have been gradually added to the university based on the local demand. These are the Faculty of Science (1961), the Faculty of Education, the Faculty of Agriculture (1973), the Faculty of Engineering (1975), the Faculty of Economics and Administrative Sciences (1987), the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine (1991), the Faculty of Mathematics (1996), the Faculty of Architecture, the Faculty of Urbanism and Islamic Arts, and the Faculty of Natural Resources and Environment (2001). In 1975 after the separation of the facultys related to the Medical Sciences from the university, the name of the university was changed from "Mashhad University” to "The Ferdowsi University of Mashhad". The Ferdowsi University of Mashhad has now nearly seven decades of brilliant educational, research and cultural history and it is well known among institutes of higher education in Iran. It is currently one of the nation’s top three universities and also the largest center of higher education in the North East of Iran. At present, the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad is composed of 12 facultys , 38 research centers, 7 centers of excellence, 820 faculty members (%50 of whom are professors or associate professors), over 20000 students (9996 undergraduate, 6143 Masters, and 3905 Ph.D. students), and 1050 staff members. Currently, 1279 foreign students are enrolled in different academic programs at the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. In addition, there are also 187 foreign students who are passing their six-month training courses in language at the International Center for Teaching Persian to Non-Persian Speakers. These students would begin their academic education after they pass this six-month course of study. title: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad: Third University in Iran
content: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad: Third University in Iran You are here: FAQ Frequently Asked Questions Academic Programs What courses does FUM offer? The Ferdowsi University of Mashhad offers a vast range of courses in the fields of Engineering, Humanities, Sciences, etc. You can browse Faculties and Departments , or Course list to know about the majors and courses. What distance learning courses are offered at FUM? The Ferdowsi University of Mashhad provides wide variety of virtual courses and subjects. You can find information about these courses and enrollment in the E-Learning Center Website. Does FUM offer Persian Language courses for non-Persian speakers? Yes! You can find related information in section International center for Teaching Persian Language to non-Persian Language speakers . Applying to FUM University Where can I find information about applying to FUM? In the section Study at FUM you can find the related information in Admission . How can I apply to FUM? To apply to the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad you need to complete the related form . This form is accessible from The Office of International Students . What are eligibility criteria to be admitted in FUM? Please visit The Office of International Students ,  Admission  section. Contact FUM How can I find contact information for FUM students, academic staff, and staff? In the Contact section from top menu you can have access to the email, website and phone number of Academics , Staff and Students . What is the phone number of the University? +98 51 3880 5000 Computer and Web Surfing Problems Where can I report a problem with a particular FUM website? You are better to contact the Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Center representative in your faculty. However, it is possible to contact with FUM English Webmaster . Dormitory and Accommodation Has FUM dormitories for international students? Yes. When you are admitted to the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad you can apply for dormitories . The related information is accessible through  Study at FUM  section and then Life on Campus . Is there dormitory for married international students and their family? Yes. The Ferdowsi University of Mashhad offers dormitory to the family of international students. How can I apply for dormitory and accommodation? When you are enrolled, you need to visit the officer of dormitory and accommodation in Student Affair Office to apply for dormitory in the first semester. General Information Where is the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad? The Ferdowsi University of Mashhad is located in Mashhad city, the Khorasan Razavi province, in the North-East of Iran. It is the biggest university in the East of the country. What is FUM mailing address? The Ferdowsi University of Mashhad, Azadi Square, Mashhad, Iran, Postal Code: 9177948974 Who is the president of FUM? The current president of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad is Professor Mohammad Kafi. Please visit the page of About , FUM presidents . Who are the vice-presidents of FUM? Please visit page About , Vice-Presidents to access up-to-date information. How old is FUM? The Ferdowsi University of Mashhad was established in 1948. Read more in the section of About then History . How can I get directions to the FUM campus? You can find the map of Mashhad and the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad in the About section, and University map . How can I donate to FUM University? The Ferdowsi Academic Foundation is responsible for donations. Please click here to donate and read more about the Ferdowsi Academic Foundation (FAF) Historical Questions Where can I learn more and find information regarding the history of FUM? Please visit About section and then History to know more about the history of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. Libraries of FUM Which libraries are available at FUM? Central Library of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad and 3 faculty libraries ( Education and Psychology , Dr. Ali Shariati Faculty of Letters and Humanities and Morteza Motahari Faculty of Theology Library ) provide library material and services to academics and students. How can I use FUM libraries? After enrollment and receiving student card, you can borrow information resources from FUM libraries . How can I find out if FUM libraries have a particular book or periodical? You should search the integrated system OPAC (Online Public Access Catalog) of the libraries of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad via the Website of the Central Library . . Please do not hesitate to contact us if you have any further questions or concerns: Email: intr@um.ac.ir Phone:  +985138802415 Fax: +985138836056 Postal Code: 9177948974 Top

Currently, we have representative members from a variety of fields such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Applied Mathematics, and Biological Sciences. At the Center of Excellence for Soft Computing and Intelligent Information Processing, our basic belief is that intelligent systems and knowledge engineering can and will play a fundamental role in the betterment of human lives. We are committed to advance the state of the art in these paradigms, to address the open and difficult problems of humanity, to build closer ties with various related industries, and to train well-qualified experts. Being placed among the most elite research universities in the country, we believe that our team at Ferdowsi University of Mashhad is well-positioned for this task. Objectives Our goal is to become an international scientific authority in soft computing and intelligent information processing by the following components Address the basic challenges of humanity by the tools of soft computing and intelligent information processing. Advance the state of the art on the worldwide theory of soft computing and intelligent information processing. Foster the recognition and advancement of the science of intelligent systems and knowledge engineering both nationally and internationally. Better introduce soft computing and intelligent information processing to the society and the industrial/academic experts Form national and international teams of academicians and industry experts to solve the basic challenges of humanity through the application of intelligent systems and knowledge engineering. Educate highly qualified experts in various related fields. Collaborate with various related industries for higher efficiency, improved design and better decisions. Help develop the required infrastructures for knowledge-based enterprises. What is soft computing: Soft computing is an umbrella term that covers the various integral paradigms of intelligent systems such as fuzzy logic, neural networks, along with other tools of intelligent information processing. Soft computing emphasizes the synergism among these paradigms of intelligence in solving the many open and difficult world problems of humanity today. Activities In its initial four years of operation, our members have published well over 600 journal articles and 460 conference papers; organized well over 40 conferences; started 12 new graduate programs in related areas, signed 5 partnership agreements with other organizations of mutual interests such as national scientific societies, other centers of excellence, and the Iran Meteorological Organization; held over 86 public speeches; advised over 210 thesis/dissertations; and supported modern facilities/equipment for 12 partner laboratories. We have now extended our center by an additional 19 national and international faculty partners in various fields of engineering, basic sciences, mathematics, and humanities. In the second course, its research activities focused on “Ferdowsi and Khorasan Literature", therefore the title: "Center of Excellence in Research on Ferdowsi Studies and Khorasan Literature" was selected. This title addressed the limited area of research. In the subsequent course, the title "The Center of Excellence in Ferdowsi Studies" was approved. This research center accomplished these course activities in 2016. Activities Holding more than 10 national and international conferences specially the annual commemoration of Ferdowsi Publishing more than 27 newsletters and 5 special issues on Epic in the Journal of Literary Studies Teaching Persian in other countries (in the past 10 years 6 faculty members have carried out teaching Persian in England, Belarus, Uzbekistan, Bangladesh, Turkmenistan, Tajikistan and Australia) Holding classes for several groups of students from Tajikistan, Middle East countries, the Caucasus, Kashmir and India Aligarh Sending 6 professors to India to hold fifteen-day retraining classes for both university professors and students in Hyderabad in 2005 Having 45 days of re-teaching Persian Language and Literature to 26 students of the Commonwealth countries in Summer 2003 Establishing and running the Persian Language Department in Tashkent (2001-2005) Holding Persian learning classes for 38 Tajiki students (2006-2007) Trying to establish and run an international Center for teaching Ferdowsi Language Sending some of our Ph.D. candidates to international conferences in Turkey, Poland, Russia, and Kazakhstan. With the rapid and vast developments in science and technology in recent years, the need for specialized research-based activities in Iran has increasingly been realized. This issue and the need to enhance the scientific potentials in the country, that is, to reduce the research gap with the developed countries and to increase the cooperation between Iranian universities, the Department of Statistics at the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad managed to establish a specialized Center of Excellence in Statistics in 2005 in agreement with three other universities, i.e., Tarbiyat Modares, Isfahan, and Birjand universities. This led to the approval of the center by the Ministry of Science, Research and Technology. Therefore, in the second course, this center was titled “Ordered and Spatial Data Center of Excellence” and continued its activities for 5 years. To expand the activities, this center has also been cooperating with Tehran University and Razi University of Kermanshah as well as the above-mentioned universities in its third course. This cooperation is based on the regulations and conditions of the Centers of Excellence in Iran, which paves the way for further interactions among Iranian universities. In 2011, after evaluation and acceptance of the proposed programs for the creation of a specialized center of excellence by the Ministry of Science, Research and Technology, this center continued its activities for another 5 years in its third course by the same title of “Ordered and Spatial Data Center of Excellence”. The Ordered and Spatial Data Center of Excellence aims to achieve the following objectives: To promote and disseminate the science of statistics in Iran To develop international scientific relations in statistics research To develop the faculty members’ potentials in statistics research To establish consulting centers of statistics To link statistics and the industry To improve statistics Its main aim is to provide services in the country as well as in neighboring countries. The center also seeks to identify infectious and noninfectious factors leading to ruminant abortion and neonatal mortality in the Khorasan provinces. Another aim of the Center of Excellence in Ruminant Abortion and Neonatal Mortality is to identify the geographical distribution of this issue. The Center’s activities cover the study of techniques for identification, prevention and controlling abortion and neonatal mortality and to present the related results to various administrative organizations and ranching. The Center of Excellence in Ruminant Abortion and Neonatal Mortality was recognized twice as a top Center in 2008 and 2011. During the last decade, a number of conferences have been organized in this field by the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad and other universities in Iran. A large number of Iranian and international researchers have attended such academic events. Members of this center have published a considerable number of research papers in the field of Analysis including Functional Analysis, Theory of Operators, Harmonic Analysis, Functional Equations, and also in the field of Algebra including Theory of Groups, Chains, Modules, and Homology. The Center of Excellence in Analysis on Algebraic Structures is attempting to achieve its aims through a range of activities and approaches such as extending the relationships between the two branches of Analysis on Algebraic Structures, i.e., Analysis and Algebraic, increasing scientific production contributing to knowledge, and developing a more dynamic environment for training talented students. Publishing significant scholarly papers by the members of this center helps the promotion of the scientific level of the country as well the region and the world. The Center of Excellence in Analysis on Algebraic Structures has the advantage of benefiting from the services of 3 Full Professors and 4 Associate Professors who have published many outstanding scientific products. The following activities occur at this scholarly center: Scientific production focusing on interdisciplinary fields Help in publishing scholarly journals in mathematics (as members of the editorial boards) Cooperation with international scientific associations (in the review of publications in Mathematics) Organizing national and international conferences and workshops and professional training courses Training future researchers through supervision of postgraduate students Providing scientific as well as financial support for talented students Cooperation with other universities in carrying out research projects Planning for running post-doctoral program The future plan of this center will be to establish an interdisciplinary branch on Analysis and Algebra. This center, which has been established in response to the global scientific need and to the future needs of this country, will be active with the collaboration between scientists in the country and abroad. This institute hosts specialists from different fields of biotechnology including molecular biology, cellular biology, molecular genetics, biochemistry, developmental biology, and other specialties. Research at FIB spans many disciplines that can be broadly categorized into four research areas; Stem Cell Biotechnology, vaccine development, recombinant proteins, and novel therapeutics. The Research Institute of Biotechnology is actively pursuing research leads in the development of platforms for production of recombinant proteins, design and development of novel vaccines, molecular studies of cancer and cancer stem cells, genome and epigenome editing. The new Theory of Wavelets and Wavelet Estimation Modules replaced classical theories including Classical Fourier Theory to solve different practical problems in Seismology, Signal Processing Systems, Telecommunications, Image Processing and Computer Vision, Elementary Particles, Theory of Approximation and Location, Forensic, Genetics and Medicine, Engineering, and Physics. Industrial centers and research laboratories try to apply the effective Wavelet Approximation Methods to enhance the quality of their products and the accuracy of their experiments. This new practical theory of Mathematics is the most effective link between Pure Mathematics and Applied Mathematics. The application of Wavelet Theory in industrial zones, universities, and high-tech laboratories like nano-technology labs can be a great help to a dramatic industrial progress in Iran. It can also solve the problems in different organizations of Iran such as telecommunications and seismology. In this regard, there is a need to educate and train experienced researchers. Establishing the Research Center for Wavelets Applications in Linear and Nonlinear Systems with the above-mentioned objectives is of significant importance to Iran. This center can be a place to conduct research projects and wavelet systems modeling as well as solving issues in Engineering, Medicine, Agriculture, Economy, Industry, Nuclear Energy, Telecommunications, and Computer Hardware and Software and providing proper solutions. Since the city of Mashhad is geographically located near the North-East gas resources of the country and also close to the Shahid Hasheminejad Refinery Station, it has a strategic situation. On the other hand, benefiting from a wealth of knowledgeable faculty members and talented students, Ferdowsi University of Mashhad has shown its capacity and capability in implementing research projects and publishing research papers in different areas of oil and gas industries. Taking this background into consideration, the establishment of the Research Institute of Oil & Gas at Ferdowsi University of Mashhad provides a platform where the problems of these industries and Oil and Gas issues can be taken into considerations. Thus, this institute has the potential to be considered as one of the leading research centers for excellence. The Research Institute of Oil & Gas at Ferdowsi University of Mashhad is established to fulfill the aims of the Iranian government in promoting research centers. It has the ability of developing and improving technologies needed for oil and gas industries. The Research Institute of Oil and Gas creates added value by training human resources required by oil and gas industries and providing related jobs. This research center is capable of not only decreasing the scientific dependence of Iran on other countries but also exporting oil and gas technologies to other countries especially to neighboring countries. SARI is a market driven research institute in the field of renewable energies set to move towards creativity, innovation and marketplace. The vision of the institute is to become a leader in the field of renewable energies, whose portfolio, research agenda and research based educational model align with the shifting needs of a developed country. The mission of the institute involves research, design, manufacturing of prototypes and commercialization as well as empowering enthusiastic graduates and graduate students for entering into the world of innovation and entrepreneurship. SARI consists of three departments of wind energy, solar energy and energy storage. Current activities are mostly focused on the wind turbine design and related research projects. Improvement of organic polymer solar cells, ion lithium batteries and redox flow batteries are some of main research areas of the institute at the time. In terms of geological features, the Eastern regions of Iran possess valuable mineral potentials. Having common borders with Central Asian countries, i.e., Afghanistan and Pakistan, this area is of particular importance regarding access to global markets. CODEI has played a significant role in establishing cooperation between academia and specialists in industry and mine sectors of the country. In this regard, CODEI has succeeded in providing necessary background for accurate identification, exploration and exploitation of the mineral resources of ore deposit in Eastern Iran. The aim of this research center is to expand the relationships between Iran and Countries in Central Asia. Achieving this goal requires continuous studies and scientific knowledge of the quantity and quality of cultural, social, political and economic relations in Central Asia. Undoubtedly, this success has prompted the distinguished scholars of Iran to develop Islamic sciences and theories. Innovations and knowledge productions in Humanities, which highlights the role of religion in the education of people and managing the society, are the key factors which helped sustain the Islamic revolution. In this regard, the significant role of seminary and university potentials of Islamic countries including Iran cannot be ignored. Seminaries, as traditional and universities as modern scientific institutions are two important places that aim to educate scholars in Iran. It is also worth mentioning that there are very few cities in Iran in which there is a well-known university as well as a reputable seminary. The Holy city of Mashhad in Iran is one such city. The seminary of Mashhad (which due to the presence of Illuminated Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Reza (A.S.) and the Holly Shrine are well recognized) along with the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad have made this city a remarkable place where seminary and university are united and become centers for Islamic studies. In 2006, seminary and university professors, the Friday prayer leader of Mashhad, and the President of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad arranged meetings in which important issues like the unity of seminary and university as well as the importance, aims, purposes and programs of this unitary were discussed. These meetings emphasized a new way of thinking in the realm of spiritual thought in Humanities. Considering the need for such studies in Iran, the Research Center for Islamic Studies in Humanities was established in 2001 by the virtue of an article number 16519/22 passed by the Ministry of Science, Research, and Technology on December 5, 2007. Aims To explain the research process in Humanities regarding Islamic ideas and theories To establish and increase the communication between university scholars and Islamic and Humanities centers To identify and study issues related to Islamic sciences and Humanities To welcome collaboration and cooperation with other national and international research centers and institutes to improve the quality of research on issues related to Islam and Humanities To conduct fundamental, practical, and developmental studies in each research department To identify different Islamic thoughts and propositions in Humanities and Social Sciences To open new horizons in research and studies, which are directly related to religion and Islamic society with the main focus on interdisciplinary ones. Departments: Islamic Economy, Islamic Management, Islamic Education, Jurisprudence and Islamic Law Missions Islamization of Humanities with regard to the potentials at Ferdowsi University of Mashhad and seminary of Mashhad Encouraging students of higher education to conduct interdisciplinary studies in Islamic sciences and Humanities Providing the proper conditions for theorizing in Islamic Humanities Identifying the research areas and gaps in Islamic Humanities Work towards Islamization of the humanities axis using the capacity of Ferdowsi University and Khorasan Seminary interaction Encourage postgraduate students to study and research in the field of interdisciplinary studies of Islamic and human sciences Trying to create a favorable environment in the field of Islamic human sciences theory Identifying Practical fields of Islamic humanities studies. Vision Research collaboration with educational or research institutions inside and outside of Iran to improve the quality of research activities in the fields of Islamic sciences and humanities Explain the research in principles of Humanities according to the Islamic viewpoints in order to achieve long-term goal to develop and research with Islamic perspectives in the field of humanities. Activities Interdisciplinary studies Arranging more than 160 open discussion meetings with the presence of distinguished university and seminary professors Arranging more than 10 specialized meetings by expert committees Compiling and publishing 2 books and translating 6 ones (in publication process) Conducting 4 research projects within the university and 2 more for other organizations which were both developmental and practical Buying books to enrich the specialized library. Research Facilities Four research groups including (Islamic economics, Islamic management, Islamic education and Islamic jurisprudence). Professional library contains more than 3,500 book. Of the total 1350 square meters of building space, 469 square meters is dedicated to research activities, 200 square meters is for research groups and the rest is for  the library users (178 square meters) and seminar rooms (91 square meters). Current Major Projects Seven research projects within the university Financial support from a dozen master's thesis in the field of interdisciplinary studies Financial support from six doctoral thesis in the field of interdisciplinary studies Two specialized books on the verge of release. The Management Research Center, established in 2006 at the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad, benefits from the services of many experienced and specialized researchers. The belief underlying the establishment of this research center is that sustainable and comprehensive development is possible only if activities of organizations and their managers are based on research findings. Animal species are of great importance for interdisciplinary studies. Indeed, these species provide the possibility of several common research projects among different branches of biological science, fundamental science, Veterinary medicine, experimental medicine and agricultural science. Animal kingdom, as the largest and the most complex category of organisms, includes an important part of the genetic resources and biological diversity.  Consequently, animals have always played an important role in benchmarking and entrepreneurship. Iran, with its high climatic variation and different terrestrial and aquatic environments, has valuable genetic resources which can lead us to develop zoological-based technologies, and to elaborate innovations in bioproduction. Finite fault and rupture processing modeling, study on earthquake hazards and Seismic tomography are some of the main interests at EQRC. An advanced permanent seismic broadband network (FUMSN) in Khorasan provinces installed and operated by EQRC, is one of the three important seismic networks in Iran. EQRC is planning to position itself in high end research and development in field of exploration geophysics as well adding two more research groups and rename itself to Institute of Geophysical Technology (IGT) in near future. Here are the long term targets of IGT: Planned purchase of 800 TFlops super-computer, IGT will support computing intensive processes such as reservoir simulation, geological modeling as well as heavy duty seismic imaging applications in near future. Recruitment of talented faculties in the field of geophysics, IGT has experienced faculty members with more than 10 years of experience in international Oil and Gas companies mainly in petroleum exploration.IGT is actively looking for team members to join us to better position itself in geophysical science in Iran. Partnering up with geophysical contractors, In addition of these, IGT is collaborating with seismic processing and interpretation companies as well as research institutes to secure some National Iranian Oil Company (NIOC) projects. Research on physics of the wave IGT is branching a new group called physics of the wave to dig deeper in the concept and mechanisms of the wave propagation in complicated mediums such as poro-viscoelastic and plastic mediums. Current Major Projects Expansion of portable and permanent broad band seismic network 800 Tflops GPU supercomputer, which can be used to perform heavy duty seismic processing applications and reservoir simulations Infrasonic Passive Differential Spectroscopy (IPDS), to detect passively (without using controlled source), the possibility of existence of a hydrocarbon reservoir Reverse time migration for better sub-surface imaging(approved by NIOC, waiting for contract) Research Facilities EQRC has a permanent broadband seismic network (FUMSN) in Khorasan provinces with 11 stations. This network provides high quality seismic data for all scientists who interested to study on earthquakes and earth sciences. Also EQRC is equipped to advanced portable seismometers for researches on special events in different parts of Iran. 12 channels surface seismic equipment (ABEM-MK8) is another facility at EQRC which make a good opportunity for graduate students to experience for near surface exploration. You may find a laboratory with shaking table, seismic wave and stick-slip fault simulators and high performance computer at EQRC. EQRC has 8 faculty members and is located in Ferdowsi university of Mashhad campus occupying around 1500 sqm of space. This office is responsible for providing suitable scientific and professional guidelines for the expansion and development of research and technology. Some of the duties of this department are policy making for research and technology, communicating with local and foreign universities, cooperating in providing scientific, cultural and social services by holding seminars and scientific conferences, publishing scientific findings and supervising all research affairs of the university, libraries and the university’s databases. The Vice-President for Research and Technology of the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad acts as the head of the University’s Research Council, the head of the Scientific Journals Council, the secretary of the University’s Scientific Poles Council, the head of the Policy Making Council for the University’s Research Centers, the secretary for the university network of deputies for research affairs and the country’s North-East research and technology associations. Faculty of Theology and Islamic Studies / Department of Islamic Civilization and Culture Department of Islamic Civilization and Culture In 1969, the Department of Islamic Civilization and Culture was establish at the Faculty of Theology at the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. Students in the Bachelor’s program are expected to develop knowledge of identifying and revitalizing resources of cultural heritage and to acknowledge the role of Iranians in the development of Islamic civilization. They are also expected to demonstrate ability to study the developmental factors as well as the obstacles in the development of Islamic civilization and to become familiar with historical geography of Islamic countries. The Department of Islamic Civilization and Culture offers Master’s program with the aim of preparing researchers in Islamic History and Arts and as a whole in different subject areas of Islamic civilization and culture. This department also trains specialists who can serve the needs of Cultural Offices and delegations of the Islamic Republic of Iran in other countries. The Department of Islamic Civilization and Culture expects graduates to be able to help the enhancement of scientific knowledge of officials and cultural specialists of governmental organizations. The Department of Islamic Civilization and Culture also offers a Doctoral program. The aim of this program is to prepare researchers as well as academics capable of teaching and carrying out research in universities and other educational institutions and specialists in Islamic studies. It also attempts to educate Islamic officials for Iranian offices and delegates in other countries. Faculty of Theology and Islamic Studies / Department of Islamic Philosophy and Theosophy Department of Islamic Philosophy and Theosophy The department of Islamic Philosophy and Theosophy was established in 1958 at the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. In this department, the students become familiar with Islamic philosophy and methods of defying atheistic ideas. The alumni are specialized in Islamic sciences and will be able to overcome incertitude in faith issues. Moreover, B.A., M.A., and Ph.D. students graduating in this major are expected to be knowledgeable in the fields of logic and mysticism. Founded in 1975, the Master’s program for Philosophy and Theosophy aims to make students familiar with philosophical and divine issues in the Islamic as well as Western world. The aim of this program is to enhance students’ capabilities in defending the Islamic principles and ideology. The doctoral program has been admitting candidates since 2011. This program aims to help students to become knowledgeable about Mulla Sadra’s philosophical theory. Mulla Sadra or Mollasadra or Sadr-ol-Mote'allehin was an Iranian Shia Islamic philosopher, theologian and scholar who led the Iranian cultural renaissance in the 17th century. The objective of this kind of study is to empower doctoral candidates with the ability to employ such theories in social issue such as ethics, politics, education, etc. More Head of the Department of Islamic Philosophy and Theosophy Gahangir Masoudi Associate Professor Department of Islamic Philosophy and Theosophy masoudi-g@um.ac.ir +985138803860 Concentration areas offered by the Department of Islamic Philosophy and Theosophy Areas Bachelor's Master's Ph.D Theology and Islamic Studies-Islamic philosophy and Theosophy - Faculty of Theology and Islamic Studies / Department of Islamic Knowledge and Sciences Department of Islamic Knowledge and Sciences The Bachelor’s program of the Department of Islamic Knowledge and Sciences was established in 2004 to offering general courses in Islamic knowledge and sciences. The Master’s program established in 2006 aims at training students for teaching courses in Islamic knowledge and sciences at universities and also institutions of higher education in Iran and other countries. This program also focuses on strengthening and improving the educational and scientific levels of the applicants to teach courses in Islamic knowledge and sciences. The graduates of this program can further their studies in Islamic knowledge and sciences. Graduates are also capable of serving as researchers at academic and research centers to perform research on Islamic thought and knowledge or on subjects related to the subjects of their studies. Founded in 2006 at the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad, the doctoral program aims at preparing lecturer for teaching Islamic Knowledge and Sciences at institutions of higher education institutions in Iran and other countries. This department also aims at strengthening and improving the educational competences and scientific levels of the faculty members in universities in the departments of Islamic Knowledge and Sciences. The graduates of this program can participate in research activities of academic and research centers in the fields of religious thought and Islamic knowledge and in subject areas related to subjects offered in Islamic knowledge and sciences program. One of the objectives of the doctoral program of the Department of Islamic Knowledge and Science is promoting the rank of current faculty members who are lecturers now at Islamic Knowledge and Sciences departments of universities to Assistant Professor. Faculty of Theology was established at the Ferdowsi University of Mashhad in 1958. The aims of this faculty are to increase the understanding of religious texts, to provide an overview of theological and doctrinal perspectives, to promote Islamic doctrines and principles, and also to deepen awareness among those who are enthusiasts in the knowledge of Islamic gnosis and worldview. In this faculty, the students of different areas and subjects become familiar with Islamic culture and civilization, religion and religious knowledge, religion and rationality, Quran and Hadith, and Philosophy and Logic. The graduates of the Faculty of Theology are capable of doing research, teaching and directing propaganda in different areas of Islamic science. Veterinary Medicine / Department of Pathobiology Department of Pathobiology The faculty members of the Department of Pathobiology are active in teaching and productive research in different subjects including Pathology, Immunology, Bacteriology and Bacterial Diseases, Virology and Viral Diseases, Mycology and Fungal Diseases, Parasitology and Parasitic Diseases, and Biotechnology. The well-equipped labs of this department support teaching and research activities in Immunology, Virology, Parasitology, Bacteriology, Mycology, and Cell Culture. In addition to teaching and research activities, this department supports laboratory services for the faculty’s clinic. For example, the Pathology section provides autopsy and histopathology. The Department of Pathobiology has been offering postgraduate programs such as a Ph.D. program for Biotechnology and Parasitology since 2007, a Master’s program for Parasitology since 2009, a Master’s program for Bacteriology since 2011, a Ph.D. program for Veterinary Pathology, and a Ph.D. program for Bacteriology since 2015. Veterinary Medicine / Department of Food Hygiene and Aquaculture Department of Food Hygiene and Aquaculture This department has different educational branches such as Food Microbiology, Food Chemistry, Milk Hygiene and Technology, Meat Hygiene and Inspection, Food Hygiene and Quality Control, Food Industry of Animal Origin, and Aquaculture and Aquatic Animal Diseases. All the teaching and research activities of the Department of Food Hygiene and Aquaculture are carried out in well-equipped, advanced and independent laboratories. In addition to carrying out teaching and research services, the various branches of the Department of Food Hygiene & Aquaculture provide services for the faculty’s clinic and other public and private institutions involved in food production and quality control. The department has established the PhD program for Food Hygiene since 2011 and the Master’s program for Food Hygiene and Quality Control since 2014. Veterinary Medicine / Department of Basic Science Department of Basic Sciences The Department of Basic Sciences at the Faculty of Veterinary Sciences benefits from a large number of academics who are active in teaching and productive in research in different fields such as Biochemistry Physiology, Pharmacology, Anatomy, Histology, Embryology, Genetics and Toxicology. The Fundamentals of structure and function of animals and human beings are comparatively studied in these fields from different perspectives such as microscopic and macroscopic, molecular, and cellular, histologic, and organismal biology. These courses provide theoretical and experimental foundations for learning physiology, different diseases, clinical and experimental courses. The Department of Basic Sciences has a number of laboratories for Biochemistry, Physiology, Pharmacology, Toxicology and Anatomy. These labs are used for teaching and research projects. Various types of research techniques are used in these labs. Based on its teaching and research capacities this department has started offering various postgraduate programs including the Ph.D. program for Comparative Histology since 2009, the Master’s program for Physiology since 2010, the Ph.D. program for Physiology, the Master’s program for Clinical Biochemistry since 2012, and the Master’s program for Histology since 2013. of Veterinary Medicine Faculty of Veterinary Medicine The Faculty of Veterinary Medicine was established in 1991. The aim of this faculty is to provide highly-skilled and expert human resources capable of carrying out research and providing health, treatment and research services in various branches of Veterinary Medicine. The initial educational programs of this faculty were: Doctor of Veterinary Medicine and Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (D.V.M). Each year a large number of students are admitted to the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine at three educational levels: Doctor of Philosophy (Ph. D.), D.V.M, and Master of Science (M.Sc.). The departments at the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine include: Basic Sciences, Pathobiology, Food Hygiene and Aquaculture, Veterinary Clinical Sciences. The Faculty of Veterinary Medicine benefits from a large number of highly productive academics carrying out research and educational activities. The results of their scientific activities have a useful impact on the development of science and technology in Iran. A few of these activities are as follows: Research, education and consultancy cooperation with many institutions and executive bodies including the Ministry of Agriculture, the Veterinary Regional Office, Razi Vaccine and Serum Research Institute, the Academic Center for Education, the Culture and Research Organization (Jihad Daneshgahi), and the University of Medical Sciences. Establishing a special animal hospital and polyclinic located 5 kilometers away from the university campus. Providing clinical and laboratory services in the polyclinic and special hospital.
